request.style: English, male baritone solo, gritty and soulful, acoustic guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, mournful, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Paul writes to the believers in Rome
A list of names in the letter of grace
Asyncritus and Phlegon are known
But Hermes stands in the open space

[Chorus]
Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes
Patrobas and Hermas with care
And the brothers who stand with them
In the circle of love that is fair

[Verse]
A Christian living in the city walls
Part of the community that he knew
Recognized by the apostle’s hand
His name is written in the view

[Chorus]
Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes
Patrobas and Hermas with care
And the brothers who stand with them
In the circle of love that is fair

[Outro]
Greet Hermes in the letter’s light
His name is kept in the Roman night
